titulo: A word of encouragement at the right time
resumen: God's encouragement often reaches us through others. Today you can give it too.

versos.texto: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

reflexion: The first chapter of Joshua ends with these words. The mention of death may sound harsh to us. As they commit themselves to Joshua for the conquest, these tribes ask that whoever rebels be put to death.

This is not permission to threaten or harm anyone who disagrees today. But notice how they end: with encouragement for their leader. They ask Joshua to be strong and courageous. It is the same thing God had told him three times in this chapter.

First, Joshua heard it from God. Now he hears it from his own people. That is often how God works. His encouragement often reaches us through others. A call, a message, a hand on the shoulder at just the right moment.

Today you can receive that encouragement. And you can also give it. Think of someone who is starting something difficult, and say a few words that lift them up. Sometimes a simple sentence holds someone up more than you imagine.
dedicatoria: This letter is for you, who are starting something new and feel afraid. You don't face it alone.
oracion: Lord, thank you for the people who encourage us. Give us courage for what today holds for us, and let our words lift others up. In Jesus' name, amen.
